title: Compile simple ASS animations into reusable timeline programs

definition.title: Compile simple ASS animations into reusable timeline programs
definition.source_excerpt: Reuse stable glyph masks with a compiled time-dependent fade/clip program for a supported ASS subset. Match libass ordering, rounding and blending across seeks; unsupported effects continue through the maintained renderer.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the exact subtitle representation, maintained renderer and existing cache behavior. Distinguish an oracle discrepancy from a player defect.
definition.minimum_probe: One authored cue/scene plus an overlapping or stateful boundary, using identical fonts, sizes and output semantics; reuse a maintained test.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the exact subtitle representation, maintained renderer and existing cache behavior. Distinguish an oracle discrepancy from a player defect. definition.primary_metric: Required caption capability or total render/extraction cost and retained cue/atlas memory.
definition.scope_contract: Independent rendering or browser-owned reference appropriate to the same contract, including hidden state, timing, ordering and clear events.
definition.negative_control: Seek into an active cue, change fonts/layout/source, or omit a required style/control. No silent simplification or stale overlay.
definition.stop_boundary: No new subtitle service, full shaping engine or font-subsetting system during first pass. Defer if the necessary observer is not available.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Same admitted subtitle renderer/assets; public cue-list/lifecycle compatibility must be addressed before virtualization.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

record.reason: Restricted fad animation reused two opacity-regime mask templates plus piecewise alpha; matches actual libass geometry/masks with at most one alpha unit at seven times including rewind. Single-mask variant fails because libass changes outline mask when fill becomes opaque. No general ASS compiler or measured gain.
